en.summary: This commit broadens L2 directory flush-response valid so clean flush steps, especially completion-relevant ones, are not suppressed by dirty-only gating.
why_it_counts: The patch modifies a central output-valid condition in the directory flush path.
It directly changes observable L2 directory protocol behavior during flush.
The affected file is the DUT directory implementation under src/L2cache.
disqualifiers: A later follow-up commit narrows this behavior again, so this change was part of an iterative repair sequence.
evidence: io.result.valid changes from Mux(RegNext(flush_issue), RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way) && flush_issue), valid_signal) to Mux(RegNext(flush_issue), true.B, valid_signal).
The changed logic controls whether the directory emits a flush result in the registered flush path.
The same module also carries flushDone and last_flush bookkeeping, confirming this is part of the directory flush engine.

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: L2 directory io.result.valid generation during flush
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: Restore the earlier io.result.valid expression that only asserts valid on the registered flush path when the current line is dirty.
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A clean terminal flush step can become invisible downstream, causing lost completion indication or a stuck flush sequence.
notes: This is an intermediate repair in a short series; for cross-DUT injection, use the portable missing-clean-completion mutation rather than literally making every flush step valid.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A flush walker may visit clean and dirty lines, but downstream control still needs a visible response at completion-relevant steps. If flush response valid is gated only by the line dirty bit, a clean terminal step can disappear from the protocol stream.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush or invalidate sequence reaches a clean line, especially the last line whose completion must still be visible downstream.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Make flush-response visibility depend only on dirty state and remove any clean-completion exception.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop completion exception from flush valid predicate
portability_notes: Map to any cache directory or tag walker that emits per-line flush responses or a final done marker.
The reusable bug is missing visible completion for clean flush steps, not a specific signal name.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that drives flush response valid or flush-completion visibility.
Gate it only with the current line dirty bit.
Do not keep a special-case valid pulse for the final clean flush step.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit changes registered flush-path valid from dirty-only gating to unconditional valid.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: At the io.result.valid assignment near flush_issue_regnext, replace the broad flush valid condition with the older dirty-only form.

evidence_for_injection: The only behavioral change is the io.result.valid condition on the flush path.
Nearby code carries last_flush in the same result bundle, tying the bug to flush protocol semantics.
The later commit 86530c17fae8f543447552bb3dfb34425e56e6ac refines this broad repair to last_flush || dirty.

zh.summary: 该提交放宽了 L2 directory 的 flush 响应 valid，使 clean flush 步骤，尤其是与完成相关的步骤，不再被仅按 dirty 位门控而静默丢掉。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了 directory flush 路径中的核心输出 valid 条件。
它直接改变了 flush 期间可观察到的 L2 directory 协议行为。
受影响文件位于 src/L2cache 下，是 DUT directory 的实现。
disqualifiers: 后续提交又收紧了这一行为，因此这个修改属于迭代修复序列的一部分。
evidence: io.result.valid 从 Mux(RegNext(flush_issue), RegNext(status_reg(flush_set).dirty(flush_way) && flush_issue), valid_signal) 改为 Mux(RegNext(flush_issue), true.B, valid_signal)。
被修改的逻辑决定了 directory 在寄存后的 flush 路径上是否发出结果。
同一模块还维护 flushDone 和 last_flush 记账，说明这里确实属于 directory flush 引擎。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: L2 directory 在 flush 期间的 io.result.valid 生成逻辑
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: 恢复较早版本的 io.result.valid 表达式，使寄存后的 flush 路径只有在当前 line 为 dirty 时才拉高 valid。
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: clean 的终止 flush 步骤可能对下游不可见，导致完成指示丢失或 flush 序列卡住。
notes: 这是短修复序列中的中间提交；做跨 DUT 注入时，应采用上面的“clean 完成不可见”变异，而不是机械地让所有 flush 步骤都 valid。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: flush walker 会遍历 clean 和 dirty line，但在与完成相关的步骤上，下游控制仍需要看到一个可见响应。如果 flush 响应 valid 只由 dirty 位决定，那么 clean 的终止步骤就可能从协议流中消失。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache flush 完成信号可见性
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: flush 或 invalidate 序列到达 clean line，尤其是最后一个必须让下游看到完成的 line。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 flush 响应可见性只依赖 dirty 状态，并去掉 clean 完成步骤的例外。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从 flush valid 谓词中删除完成例外
portability_notes: 可映射到任何发出逐行 flush 响应或最终 done 标记的 cache directory 或 tag walker。
可复用的错误本质是 clean flush 完成步骤对下游不可见，而不是某个特定信号名。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到驱动 flush 响应 valid 或 flush 完成可见性的逻辑。
把它改成仅由当前 line 的 dirty 位控制。
不要为最后一个 clean flush 步骤保留特殊 valid 脉冲。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Directory_test 中 flush 路径的 io.result.valid 生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把寄存后的 flush 路径 valid 从仅 dirty 时有效改成了无条件有效。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在靠近 flush_issue_regnext 的 io.result.valid 赋值处，把较宽松的 flush valid 条件改回旧的仅 dirty 形式。

evidence_for_injection: 唯一的行为性改动就是 flush 路径上的 io.result.valid 条件。
同一结果 bundle 中还有 last_flush 字段，说明问题属于 flush 协议语义。
后续提交 86530c17fae8f543447552bb3dfb34425e56e6ac 又把条件细化为 last_flush || dirty。
